floorPlans.introduction: Compare four-, five- and six-bedroom villas in Chamfer, Contemporary and Classic styles as shown in the shared Emaar pack. Match the layout and basement configuration to your plot.
floorPlans.note: The two releases share this Emaar design pack. The five-bedroom Chamfer sheet without a basement prints 7,965.50 sq ft, 0.28 sq ft above its listed components. Confirm the signed plan and area for your plot.

review.images: Reviewed the exact wide hero and six official gallery images. The hero shows the wider Oasis development. The lagoon image appears beside the Marèva 2 heading on physical brochure page 9. Captions identify proposed scenes and the broader context.
review.location: Matched the named developer point. Visually verified the original map on brochure page 5 and all four driving estimates on page 5.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed 11 physical pages and kept 10 complete villa sheets from the shared booklet linked by the exact official Marèva 2 page. Tanami’s phase-specific schedule independently lists all 10 printed totals and styles. Physical page 5 reports 7965.50 sq ft versus a 7965.22 component sum. Printed totals retained. Phase corroboration: https://www.tanamiproperties.com/Projects/Mareva-2-at-The-Oasis-FloorPlans

unavailable: The shared plan pack gives published design areas. The plan and plot assignment of an individual villa and its signed area were not verified.
